name: Metabase
description: Open source business intelligence and analytics platform. Create dashboards and explore data without writing SQL.
summary: Metabase is actively maintained with frequent patch releases across multiple supported branches. The latest release is v0.63.14 (Open Source) / v1.63.14 (Enterprise), released on August 20, 2025. Multiple branches (v58–v63) are receiving concurrent patch updates, indicating a robust LTS-style support model. Full changelogs are available at https://github.com/metabase/metabase/releases.

answers.What is the current license?: Open Source edition uses AGPL v3; Enterprise edition uses a commercial license.
answers.Is the project actively maintained?: Yes — multiple releases across several branches published in August 2025, with 48.9k+ GitHub stars.
answers.Is there a cloud-hosted version availabl: Yes — Metabase Cloud (managed cloud) is available at https://www.metabase.com.
answers.Does it support SSO and SAML authenticat: Yes — SSO and SAML are supported in the Enterprise edition.
answers.What databases/data sources are supporte: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server, SQLite, Oracle, BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, MongoDB, Presto, Druid, SparkSQL, and more (via drivers).

alternatives.name: Redash
alternatives.review: Open source, query-focused, simpler feature set.

alternatives.name: Apache Superset
alternatives.review: Apache-licensed, rich visualisation library, steeper setup curve.

alternatives.name: Grafana
alternatives.review: Primarily metrics/time-series but increasingly used for general BI.

alternatives.name: Hex
alternatives.review: Close source, enterprise focus, AI Analytics Platform for your whole team

alternatives.name: Tableau
alternatives.review: Tableau offers best-in-class visualizations and enterprise features but is significantly more expensive and not open source unlike Metabase.

alternatives.name: Lightdash
alternatives.review: Lightdash integrates tightly with dbt for a metrics-first approach and is open source, but has a smaller ecosystem and community than Metabase.
